newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Blasts in Tel Aviv, no serious injuries - media.
newsitem.headline: Blasts in Tel Aviv, no serious injuries - media.

text.p: An explosion rocked a Tel Aviv neighbourhood on Thursday, injuring at least five people, Israel Army Radio said.
Israel Television said two explosions were heard in central Tel Aviv and police and ambulances were rushing to the scene.
The blasts occurred near Tel Aviv's central bus station.
Israel Radio said none of the injured sustained serious wounds and that police were examining a possible third explosive device.
